Messages.Author: Malefax
Messages.Body:
Cards such as Powerbase: Mexico city, Powerbase: NY, etc. are burned when
the last counters are removed from them, and the counters can be stolen as a
direct action. Since this is a case of a location being burned by another
methuselah's card (i.e., the vampire that performed the action), is the
gaurdian ghoul's power triggered? If so, is the blood left on the card?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:



No.

The blood leaves the card.

When the blood leaves the card, the destroy location effect is
triggered. If the blood hasn't left the card, the destroy location effect
isn't triggered. When you get to the consecration rites/guardian ghoul
bit, there is no blood on the card or you wouldn't be dealing with them.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe <jr...@cam.ac.uk> wrote:

> No. The blood leaves the card.
> When the blood leaves the card, the destroy location effect is
> triggered. If the blood hasn't left the card, the destroy
> location effect isn't triggered. When you get to the
> consecration rites/guardian ghoul bit, there is no blood on the
> card or you wouldn't be dealing with them.

Correct. So, you could "save" the location via Guardian Ghoul,
but then it would immediately be burned again, since it has no
counters.
